mapper.select: select a.* from (select b.*, CASE WHEN b.INVALID_DATE IS NOT NULL AND b.INVALID_DATE < DATE(NOW()) then '已过期' WHEN b.INVALID_DATE IS NOT NULL AND b.INVALID_DATE <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) then '临近1个月' ELSE '正常' END AS validityStatus from ENTERPRISE_HONOR b where b.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE') a ${ew.customSqlSegment}

select a.* from (select b.*, CASE WHEN b.INVALID_DATE IS NOT NULL AND b.INVALID_DATE < DATE(NOW()) then '已过期' WHEN b.INVALID_DATE IS NOT NULL AND b.INVALID_DATE <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) then '临近1个月' ELSE '正常' END AS validityStatus from ENTERPRISE_HONOR b where b.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE') a where a.ID = #{id}
